normalized.description: ObjectivesExplore topologies based on GaN switches and digital control to discharge primarybatteries down the minimum possible voltage.The objective is to maximise the use of the energy in primary batteries.Build a breadboard with the most promising option and test its performance.DescriptionPrimary batteries have very high energy density but they cannot be recharged. Sincethey will not be recharged, primary batteries make total sense.To extract the maximum amount of energy,the battery voltage will go down as the currentis taken out. The lower you go in voltage, the more energy you extract.However, decreasing the voltage has serious implications for the power system. In general,DC/DC converters operate at high efficiency levels in a narrow input voltage range.Moreover, the topologies will limit the maximum and minimum input voltage, which meansthat, in mostcases, the DC/DC converter used to discharge the battery will limit theoperation and the performance.This activity aims at exploring DC/DC converter topologies that can operate through largeinput voltage ranges with high performance.
